<Routines>
<Routine Name="Logic" Type="RLL">
<RLLContent>
<Rung Number="0" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[#################################################################################
VARIABLE SPEED MODULE (VSM)

CONTROL START/STOP OF A VSM MOTOR AND MONITOR MOTOR STATUSES
DETERMINE START LIMITS, DISCREPANCY ALARM STATUS, RUN TIMES, AND OTHER STATUSES.
################################################################################]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[#################################################################################
VARIABLE SPEED MODULE (VSM)

CONTROL START/STOP OF A VSM MOTOR AND MONITOR MOTOR STATUSES
DETERMINE START LIMITS, DISCREPANCY ALARM STATUS, RUN TIMES, AND OTHER STATUSES.
################################################################################]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[NOP();]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="1" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************
MOTOR RUNNING STATUS FOR HMI
****************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************
MOTOR RUNNING STATUS FOR HMI
****************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(DI_MTR_RUN_IND)OTE(B_PMP_IS_RUN);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="2" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[*************************************************************************************************
START  LIMIT LOGIC

CALCULATE SET POINT FOR TIMER TO CALCULATE START LIMIT TIME

ENTER THE NUMBER OF STARTS PER HOUR IN "D_STRT_PER_HR" iF GREATER THAN '0' THEN 
RUN THE DIVIDE MODULE TO GET THE MILLISECONDS BETWEEN STARTS
EXAMPLE: 6 STARTS PER HOUR HAS A SETPOINT OF 600,000 MILLISECONDS
***************************************************************************************************
]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[*************************************************************************************************
START  LIMIT LOGIC

CALCULATE SET POINT FOR TIMER TO CALCULATE START LIMIT TIME

ENTER THE NUMBER OF STARTS PER HOUR IN "D_STRT_PER_HR" iF GREATER THAN '0' THEN 
RUN THE DIVIDE MODULE TO GET THE MILLISECONDS BETWEEN STARTS
EXAMPLE: 6 STARTS PER HOUR HAS A SETPOINT OF 600,000 MILLISECONDS
***************************************************************************************************
]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[DIV(3600000,HMI_STRT_PR_HR,TMR_BTWN_STRT.PRE);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="3" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[********************************************************************
OUTPUT TIMER PULSE FOR EACH ALLOWABLE
START TIME PERIOD

IF THE "TMR_BTWN_STRT" TIMER IS NOT DONE THE LET THE TIME ACCUMULATE
WHEN IT IS DONE THE TIMER STARTS OVER AND CONTINUOUSLY TIMES
********************************************************************
]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[********************************************************************
OUTPUT TIMER PULSE FOR EACH ALLOWABLE
START TIME PERIOD

IF THE "TMR_BTWN_STRT" TIMER IS NOT DONE THE LET THE TIME ACCUMULATE
WHEN IT IS DONE THE TIMER STARTS OVER AND CONTINUOUSLY TIMES
********************************************************************
]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(TMR_BTWN_STRT.DN)GRT(CTR_MTR_STRTS.ACC,0)TON(TMR_BTWN_STRT,?,?);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="4" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[**************************************************************************************
THE FOLLOWING TWO RUNGS USE A COUNTER TO COUNT UP MOTOR STARTS 
AND COUNT DOWN FOR ALLOWABLE START INTERVALS.
NOTE: STARTS ARE TOO FREQUENT IF COUNTER REACHES 2

WHEN "DI_MTR_RNNG_SGNL" TRANSITIONS TO A '1' A ONE-SHOT 
ALLOWS THE UP COUNTER TO INCREASE THE "CTR_MTR_STRTS" VALUE

WHEN THE PERIOD BWTWEEN STARTS "TMR_BTWN_STRT.DN" TRANSITIONS TO A '1'
AND IF THE "CTR_MTR_STRTS" IS GREATER THAN '0' THEN
ALLOW THE DOWN COUNTER TO DECREASE THE "CTR_MTR_STRTS" VALUE

THE "CTR_MTR_STRS" VALUE CAN BE USED BY THE HMI TO INDICATE WHY AN
OPERATOR IS NOT ABLE TO INITIATE A START WITHIN THE START INTERVAL
**************************************************************************************
]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[**************************************************************************************
THE FOLLOWING TWO RUNGS USE A COUNTER TO COUNT UP MOTOR STARTS 
AND COUNT DOWN FOR ALLOWABLE START INTERVALS.
NOTE: STARTS ARE TOO FREQUENT IF COUNTER REACHES 2

WHEN "DI_MTR_RNNG_SGNL" TRANSITIONS TO A '1' A ONE-SHOT 
ALLOWS THE UP COUNTER TO INCREASE THE "CTR_MTR_STRTS" VALUE

WHEN THE PERIOD BWTWEEN STARTS "TMR_BTWN_STRT.DN" TRANSITIONS TO A '1'
AND IF THE "CTR_MTR_STRTS" IS GREATER THAN '0' THEN
ALLOW THE DOWN COUNTER TO DECREASE THE "CTR_MTR_STRTS" VALUE

THE "CTR_MTR_STRS" VALUE CAN BE USED BY THE HMI TO INDICATE WHY AN
OPERATOR IS NOT ABLE TO INITIATE A START WITHIN THE START INTERVAL
**************************************************************************************
]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(DI_MTR_RUN_IND)ONS(ONS_FVM_LGC.7)CTU(CTR_MTR_STRTS,?,?);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="5" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(TMR_BTWN_STRT.DN)CTD(CTR_MTR_STRTS,?,?);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="6" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(CTR_MTR_STRTS.DN)OTE(B_STRT_LIM_WRN_ON);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="7" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
SET HMI MOTOR REMOTE STATUS BASED ON SWITCH INPUT STATUS
***********************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
SET HMI MOTOR REMOTE STATUS BASED ON SWITCH INPUT STATUS
***********************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(DI_MTR_HOA_AUTO)OTE(B_IN_AUTO);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="8" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
SET HMI MOTOR LOCAL HAND STATUS BASED ON SWITCH INPUT STATUS
***********************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
SET HMI MOTOR LOCAL HAND STATUS BASED ON SWITCH INPUT STATUS
***********************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIC(DI_MTR_HOA_HAND)OTE(B_HMI_HOA_HND_IN);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="9" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[************************************************************************************************************
MOVE MOTOR AMPS TO AN HMI REGISTER FOR DISPLAY PURPOSES
************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[************************************************************************************************************
MOVE MOTOR AMPS TO AN HMI REGISTER FOR DISPLAY PURPOSES
************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[MOV(AI_MOTOR_AMPS,R_AMPS_IND);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="10" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[************************************************************************************************************
MOVE MOTOR AMPS TO AN HMI REGISTER FOR DISPLAY PURPOSES
************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[************************************************************************************************************
MOVE MOTOR AMPS TO AN HMI REGISTER FOR DISPLAY PURPOSES
************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[MOV(AI_SPD_FB_SGNL,R_SPD_FB_IND);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="11" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
@@@@@@@@@@@    EQUIPMENT AVAILABILITY LOGIC   @@@@@@@@@@

DETERMINE IF THE EQUIPMENT IS UNAVAILABLE FOR PLC CONTROL
THE MOTOR IS NOT AVAILABLE IF
IT IS NOT IN REMOTE
IT IS NOT RUNNING AND HAS A MOISTURE ALARM
IT HAS A FAULT, OVER TEMP, OR DISCREPANCY ALARM
ITS RUN PERMISSIVE IS OFF
IT IS NOT RUNNING AND ITS START PERMISSIVE IS OFF
IT IS START LIMITED AND THE FILTER IS SET TO PREVENT A START
more work here to clarify required resets from hmi >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
***********************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
@@@@@@@@@@@    EQUIPMENT AVAILABILITY LOGIC   @@@@@@@@@@

DETERMINE IF THE EQUIPMENT IS UNAVAILABLE FOR PLC CONTROL
THE MOTOR IS NOT AVAILABLE IF
IT IS NOT IN REMOTE
IT IS NOT RUNNING AND HAS A MOISTURE ALARM
IT HAS A FAULT, OVER TEMP, OR DISCREPANCY ALARM
ITS RUN PERMISSIVE IS OFF
IT IS NOT RUNNING AND ITS START PERMISSIVE IS OFF
IT IS START LIMITED AND THE FILTER IS SET TO PREVENT A START
more work here to clarify required resets from hmi >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
***********************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[[XIO(DI_MTR_HOA_AUTO) ,XIO(DI_MTR_RUN_IND) XIC(B_MST_ALM_ON) ,XIO(DI_MTR_RUN_IND) XIC(HMI_PRVT_LMT_STRT) XIC(B_STRT_LIM_WRN_ON) ,XIC(BI_OT_ALM_ON) ,XIC(B_DSCR_ALM_ON) ,XIC(B_FLT_ALM_ON) ,XIO(B_PLC_PRMSV_2) ,XIO(DI_MTR_RUN_IND) XIO(B_PLC_PRMSV_1) ]OTE(B_PMP_UNVLBL);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="12" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[************************************************************************************
DETERMINE MOTOR OPERATING MODE FROM HMI AUTO/MANUAL SELECTOR
VALUE (0 = MANUAL, 1 = AUTO1, 2 = AUTO2, 3 = AUTO3 ...)

THIS ALLOWS THE EQUIPMENT TO BE CONTROLLED MANUALLY (0) OR 
BY SEVERAL (1-9) DIFFERENT AVAILABLE MODES OF AUTOMATIC CONTROL
NOTE: ADD MORE RUNGS FOR ADDITIONAL AUTO MODES OF CONTROL
*************************************************************************************
]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[************************************************************************************
DETERMINE MOTOR OPERATING MODE FROM HMI AUTO/MANUAL SELECTOR
VALUE (0 = MANUAL, 1 = AUTO1, 2 = AUTO2, 3 = AUTO3 ...)

THIS ALLOWS THE EQUIPMENT TO BE CONTROLLED MANUALLY (0) OR 
BY SEVERAL (1-9) DIFFERENT AVAILABLE MODES OF AUTOMATIC CONTROL
NOTE: ADD MORE RUNGS FOR ADDITIONAL AUTO MODES OF CONTROL
*************************************************************************************
]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[EQU(D_HMI_AUTO_MAN_SEL,0)OTE(B_IN_MAN_IND);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="13" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[EQU(D_HMI_AUTO_MAN_SEL,1)OTE(B_IN_AUTO1_IND);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="14" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[EQU(D_HMI_AUTO_MAN_SEL,2)OTE(B_IN_AUTO2_IND);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="15" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************
@@@@@@@@@@@@@@   MOTOR ALARMS LOGIC   @@@@@@@@@@@@
****************************************************************************************************
]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************
@@@@@@@@@@@@@@   MOTOR ALARMS LOGIC   @@@@@@@@@@@@
****************************************************************************************************
]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[NOP();]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="16" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
ANALOG DESCREPANCY LOGIC

IF THE EQUIPMWENT IS AVAILABLE AND DEPENDING ON WHICH MODE THE EQUIPMENT MODULE IS IN, 
COMPARE THE NEW VALUE TO THE PREVIOUS VALUE
IF THE NEW VALUE IS NOT THE SAME AS THE PREVIOUS VALUE 
THEN LATCH THE ANALOG_REQ_OUTPUT_VALUE_CHANGED BIT
NOTE: THE NEQ TRUE STATEMENT TYPICALLY WILL ONLY HAPPEN FOR ONE SCAN
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
ANALOG DESCREPANCY LOGIC

IF THE EQUIPMWENT IS AVAILABLE AND DEPENDING ON WHICH MODE THE EQUIPMENT MODULE IS IN, 
COMPARE THE NEW VALUE TO THE PREVIOUS VALUE
IF THE NEW VALUE IS NOT THE SAME AS THE PREVIOUS VALUE 
THEN LATCH THE ANALOG_REQ_OUTPUT_VALUE_CHANGED BIT
NOTE: THE NEQ TRUE STATEMENT TYPICALLY WILL ONLY HAPPEN FOR ONE SCAN
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(B_PMP_UNVLBL)[XIC(B_IN_MAN_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO1_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO2_IND) NEQ(HMI_MAN_SPD_CMD,R_HMI_SPD_CMD_PREV_VALUE) ONS(ONS_FVM_LGC.4) ,XIO(B_IN_MAN_IND) XIC(B_IN_AUTO1_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO2_IND) NEQ(R_PLC_AUTO1_SPD_CTRL,AUTO1_ANALOG_REQ_PREVIOUS_VALUE) ONS(ONS_FVM_LGC.5) ,XIO(B_IN_MAN_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO1_IND) XIC(B_IN_AUTO2_IND) NEQ(R_PLC_AUTO2_SPD_CTRL,AUTO2_ANALOG_REQ_PREVIOUS_VALUE) ONS(ONS_FVM_LGC.6) ]OTL(B_ANLG_REQ_VALUE_CHANGED);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="17" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMWENT IS AVAILABLE AND DEPENDING ON WHICH MODE THE EQUIPMENT MODULE IS IN, 
MOVE THE CORRESPONDING ANALOG VALUE TO THE EQUIPMENT MODULE ANALOG OUTPUT
AND MOVE THE NEW VALUE INTO THE PREVIOUS VALUE REGISTER
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMWENT IS AVAILABLE AND DEPENDING ON WHICH MODE THE EQUIPMENT MODULE IS IN, 
MOVE THE CORRESPONDING ANALOG VALUE TO THE EQUIPMENT MODULE ANALOG OUTPUT
AND MOVE THE NEW VALUE INTO THE PREVIOUS VALUE REGISTER
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(B_PMP_UNVLBL)[XIC(B_IN_MAN_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO1_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO2_IND) [MOV(HMI_MAN_SPD_CMD,AO_DMND_SPD) ,MOV(R_HMI_MAN_SPD_CMD,R_HMI_SPD_CMD_PREV_VALUE) ] ,XIO(B_IN_MAN_IND) XIC(B_IN_AUTO1_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO2_IND) [MOV(R_PLC_AUTO1_SPD_CTRL,AO_DMND_SPD) ,MOV(AUTO1_ANALOG_REQ,AUTO1_ANALOG_REQ_PREVIOUS_VALUE) ] ,XIO(B_IN_MAN_IND) XIO(B_IN_AUTO1_IND) XIC(B_IN_AUTO2_IND) [MOV(R_PLC_AUTO2_SPD_CTRL,AO_DMND_SPD) ,MOV(AUTO2_ANALOG_REQ,AUTO2_ANALOG_REQ_PREVIOUS_VALUE) ] ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="18" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
ANALOG CONTROL AND TRACKING LOGIC FOR MANUAL MODE

WHEN THE EQUIMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR CONTROL AND IN MANUAL MODE 
THE SPEED IS SET FROM THE HMI
WHEN NOT IN MANUAL MODE THE SPEED FEEDBACK FROM THE FIELD INPUT 
IS MOVED INTO THE R_HMI_MAN_SPD_CTRL ALLOWING FRO BUMPLESS TRANSFER
FROM THE OTHER MODES OF CONTROL
***********************************************************************************************
]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************
ANALOG CONTROL AND TRACKING LOGIC FOR MANUAL MODE

WHEN THE EQUIMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR CONTROL AND IN MANUAL MODE 
THE SPEED IS SET FROM THE HMI
WHEN NOT IN MANUAL MODE THE SPEED FEEDBACK FROM THE FIELD INPUT 
IS MOVED INTO THE R_HMI_MAN_SPD_CTRL ALLOWING FRO BUMPLESS TRANSFER
FROM THE OTHER MODES OF CONTROL
***********************************************************************************************
]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(B_PMP_UNVLBL)XIO(B_IN_MAN_IND)MOV(AI_SPD_FB_SGNL,HMI_MAN_SPD_CMD);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="19" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR PLC CONTROL, 
COMPUTE THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE REQESTED OUTPUT VALUE
AND THE ANALOG FEEDBACK VALUE
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR PLC CONTROL, 
COMPUTE THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE REQESTED OUTPUT VALUE
AND THE ANALOG FEEDBACK VALUE
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(B_PMP_UNVLBL)CPT(R_ANLG_ACT_VS_REQ_VAL_DELTA,AO_DMND_SPD - AI_SPD_FB_SGNL);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="20" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMWENT IS AVAILABLE AND IN MANUAL MODE, 
1) MOVE THE ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER SETPOINT TO THE TIMER PRESET
2) TAKE THE ABSOLUTE VALUE OF THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE REQESTED 
OUTPUT VALUE AND THE ANALOG FEEDBACK VALUE
3) IF THE ABSOLUTE VALUE IS GREATER THAN THE ANALOG DEADBAND SETPOINT
START THE ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMWENT IS AVAILABLE AND IN MANUAL MODE, 
1) MOVE THE ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER SETPOINT TO THE TIMER PRESET
2) TAKE THE ABSOLUTE VALUE OF THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE REQESTED 
OUTPUT VALUE AND THE ANALOG FEEDBACK VALUE
3) IF THE ABSOLUTE VALUE IS GREATER THAN THE ANALOG DEADBAND SETPOINT
START THE ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(B_PMP_UNVLBL)ABS(R_ANLG_ACT_VS_REQ_VAL_DELTA,R_ANLG_ACT_VS_REQ_VAL_DELTA_ABS);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="21" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE REQESTED OUTPUT VALUE
IS LESS THAN THE ANALOG DEADBAND SETPOINT VALUE
THEN THE VALUE CHANGE REQUEST IS COMPLETE
UNLATCH THE ANALOG_REQ_OUTPUT_VALUE_CHANGED BIT
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE REQESTED OUTPUT VALUE
IS LESS THAN THE ANALOG DEADBAND SETPOINT VALUE
THEN THE VALUE CHANGE REQUEST IS COMPLETE
UNLATCH THE ANALOG_REQ_OUTPUT_VALUE_CHANGED BIT
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(R_ANLG_ACT_VS_REQ_VAL_DELTA_ABS <= HMI_DEV_DB)OTU(B_ANLG_REQ_VALUE_CHANGED);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="22" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR CONTROL AND THE ANALOG REQESTED VALUE HAS CHANGED
THEN MOVE THE HMI ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER SETPOINT INTO THE TIMER PRESET VALUE
AND START THE TIMER.
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR CONTROL AND THE ANALOG REQESTED VALUE HAS CHANGED
THEN MOVE THE HMI ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER SETPOINT INTO THE TIMER PRESET VALUE
AND START THE TIMER.
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(B_PMP_UNVLBL)XIC(B_ANLG_REQ_VALUE_CHANGED)MUL(HMI_DSCR_ALM_DLY,1000,ANLG_DSCR_TON.PRE)TON(ANLG_DSCR_TON,?,?);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="23" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR CONTROL AND THE ANALOG REQUESTED VALUE HAS CHANGED
AND THE ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER IS DONE THEN SET THE EQUIPMENT MODULE DESCREPANCY ALARM
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[****************************************************************************************************************
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS AVAILABLE FOR CONTROL AND THE ANALOG REQUESTED VALUE HAS CHANGED
AND THE ANALOG DESCREPANCY TIMER IS DONE THEN SET THE EQUIPMENT MODULE DESCREPANCY ALARM
****************************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(B_PMP_UNVLBL)XIC(B_ANLG_REQ_VALUE_CHANGED)XIC(ANLG_DSCR_TON.DN)ONS(ONS_FVM_LGC.3)OTE(B_ANLG_DSCR_ALRM);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="24" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[*****************************************************
DISCREPANCY ALARM
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS REQUESTED TO RUN OR A SPEED CHANGE IS INTIATED 
AFTER A SET PERIOD OF TIME THE EQUIPMENT IS
NOT RUNNING OR HAS NOT REACHED THE REQUESTED SPEED (+/- DEADBAND)
A DISCREPANCY ALARM IS SET
******************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[*****************************************************
DISCREPANCY ALARM
IF THE EQUIPMENT IS REQUESTED TO RUN OR A SPEED CHANGE IS INTIATED 
AFTER A SET PERIOD OF TIME THE EQUIPMENT IS
NOT RUNNING OR HAS NOT REACHED THE REQUESTED SPEED (+/- DEADBAND)
A DISCREPANCY ALARM IS SET
******************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(HMI_DSCR_ALM_DSBL)[MUL(HMI_DSCR_ALM_DLY,1000,ALM_DSCR.MinDurationPRE) ,XIC(B_HMI_ALM_ACK_REQ) OTE(ALM_DSCR.AckRequired) ,XIC(HMI_DSCR_ALM_LTCH) OTE(ALM_DSCR.Latched) ,OTE(B_ENBL_DSCR_ALM) ,[[XIC(DO_PLC_STRT_CMD) ,XIC(DI_MTR_HOA_HAND) ] XIO(DI_MTR_RUN_IND) ,XIO(DO_PLC_STRT_CMD) XIO(DI_MTR_HOA_HAND) XIC(DI_MTR_RUN_IND) ,XIC(B_ANLG_DSCR_ALRM) ] ALMD(ALM_DSCR,B_HMI_ALM_ACK,B_HMI_ALM_RES,HMI_DSCR_ALM_DSBL,B_ENBL_DSCR_ALM) ,XIC(ALM_DSCR.InAlarm) OTE(B_DSCR_ALM_ON) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="25" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************************
DEVIATION ALARM LOGIC

IF A CHANGE IN ANALOG VALUE HAS NOT BEEN REQUESTED
AND THE SPEED CALL AND FEEDBACK DO NOT AGREE
WITHIN DEADBAND SETPOINT THEN A DEVIATION ALARM HAS OCCURED
***********************************************************************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[***********************************************************************************************************
DEVIATION ALARM LOGIC

IF A CHANGE IN ANALOG VALUE HAS NOT BEEN REQUESTED
AND THE SPEED CALL AND FEEDBACK DO NOT AGREE
WITHIN DEADBAND SETPOINT THEN A DEVIATION ALARM HAS OCCURED
***********************************************************************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[SUB(AI_SPD_FB_SGNL,AO_DMND_SPD,R_VSD_DEV)ABS(R_VSD_DEV,R_VSD_DEV);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="26" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[XIO(HMI_DEV_ALM_DSBL)XIO(B_ANLG_REQ_VALUE_CHANGED)[MUL(HMI_DEV_ALM_DLY,1000,ALM_DEV.MinDurationPRE) ,XIC(B_HMI_ALM_ACK_REQ) OTE(ALM_DEV.AckRequired) ,XIC(HMI_DEV_ALM_LTCH) OTE(ALM_DEV.Latched) ,OTE(B_ENBL_DEV_ALM) ,GRT(R_VSD_DEV,HMI_DEV_DB) ALMD(ALM_DEV,B_HMI_ALM_ACK,B_HMI_ALM_RES,HMI_DEV_ALM_DSBL,B_ENBL_DEV_ALM) ,XIC(ALM_DEV.InAlarm) OTE(B_DEV_ALM_ON) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="27" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[*****************************************************
FAULT ALARM
MOTOR FAULT INPUT TRIPPED
******************************************************]]>
<LocalizedComment Lang="en-US">
<![CDATA[*****************************************************
FAULT ALARM
MOTOR FAULT INPUT TRIPPED
******************************************************]]>
</LocalizedComment>
</Comment>

<AddOnInstructionDefinition Name="ISA88_WiegersProcessInnovation" Class="Standard" Revision="1.0" Vendor="WPI" ExecutePrescan="true" ExecutePostscan="false" ExecuteEnableInFalse="false" CreatedDate="2020-11-13T12:57:02.407Z" CreatedBy="WPI\engineer" EditedDate="2022-06-02T08:49:25.662Z" EditedBy="WPI\tom.reit"
 SoftwareRevision="v33.00">
<Description>
<![CDATA[PackML ]]>
</Description>
<AdditionalHelpText>
<![CDATA[Bij een productie omgeving horen natuurlijk vele fysieke elementen, kleppen, pompen, tanks, koelers en mengers bijvoorbeeld. Deze elementen worden samen gebracht in een fysiek model waardoor vanuit basis elementen (control modules) complexere elementen kunnen worden opgebouwd. Met het samen brengen van deze control modules ontstaat bijvoorbeeld een tank met een functie. Deze tank kan dan als basis(template) dienen voor de volgende gelijke tanks. Op deze manier hoeft maar 1 complex element ontworpen en beschreven te worden. De gehele structuur van het fysieke model is als volgt:

Site – Een fabrieksterrein, bijvoorbeeld productie locatie Y.
Area – Een deel van een site waar zich een process cell kan bevinden, gebouw X.
Process Cell – Een deel van een fabriek met verschillende Units
Unit – Een deel van een fabriek waar een bepaald product een verandering ondergaat.
Equipment Module – Een verzameling van control modules die een taak verrichten, vullen, koelen, mengen.
Control Module – Een klep, pomp, motor.]]>
</AdditionalHelpText>

<Routine Name="Logic" Type="ST">
<STContent>
<Line Number="0">
<![CDATA[TRUE:=1;								// macro for bool]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="1">
<![CDATA[FALSE:=0;								// macro for bool]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="2">
<![CDATA[feedbackTimer.PRE:=FeedbackTime;		// timer.pre]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="3">
<![CDATA[TONR(feedbackTimer);					// timer object]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="4">
<![CDATA[reset_ons.InputBit:=reset;				// map reset signal to oneshot ]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="5">
<![CDATA[OSFI(reset_ons);						// reset on falling edge object]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="6">
<![CDATA[if Manual_Turn_On AND NOT (PackML.Sts_Manual AND PackML.wrk_Execute) then Manual_Turn_On:=0; end_if;		// prevent manual start when machine is not in correct state]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="7">
<![CDATA[#region reset once faulted]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="8">
<![CDATA[	if reset_ons.OutputBit then				]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="9">
<![CDATA[		if Error OR State=4 then	]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="10">
<![CDATA[			Error	:=FALSE;			// reset error state]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="11">
<![CDATA[			State	:=0;				// set valve in 0 state]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="12">
<![CDATA[		end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="13">
<![CDATA[	end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="14">
<![CDATA[#endregion]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="15">
<![CDATA[#region Valve is normally closed]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="16">
<![CDATA[/* ]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="17">
<![CDATA[NO_or_NC = TRUE,	then valve will be Normally closed]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="18">
<![CDATA[NO_or_NC = FALSE, 	then valve will be Normally open]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="19">
<![CDATA[*/]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="20">
<![CDATA[	if NO_or_NC then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="21">
<![CDATA[		if NOT 	Manual_Turn_On AND 		Turn_On then State:=1; HMI_color:=1; end_if; // valve is turned on by program.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="22">
<![CDATA[		if 		Manual_Turn_On AND 	NOT	Turn_On then State:=3; HMI_color:=3; end_if; // valve is turned on by manual.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="23">
<![CDATA[		if NOT	Manual_Turn_On AND 	NOT	Turn_On then State:=0; HMI_color:=0; end_if; // valve is turned NOT turned on.		]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="24">
<![CDATA[	end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="25">
<![CDATA[#endregion]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="26">
<![CDATA[#region Valve is normally open]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="27">
<![CDATA[	if NOT NO_or_NC then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="28">
<![CDATA[		if NOT 	Manual_Turn_On AND 		Turn_On then State:=0; HMI_color:=1; end_if; // valve is turned off.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="29">
<![CDATA[		if 		Manual_Turn_On AND 	NOT	Turn_On then State:=0; HMI_color:=3; end_if; // valve is turned off by manual.]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="30">
<![CDATA[		if NOT	Manual_Turn_On AND 	NOT	Turn_On then State:=1; HMI_color:=0; end_if; // valve is turned on.	]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="31">
<![CDATA[	end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="32">
<![CDATA[#endregion]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="33">
<![CDATA[#region feedback timer]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="34">
<![CDATA[/*]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="35">
<![CDATA[once feedback signal is not equals to valveout signal start feedback timer, if timer reaches .dn generate an error. ]]>

<Line Number="36">
<![CDATA[if feedback signal is ealier back then timeout time reset the timer. ]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="37">

</Line>
<Line Number="38">
<![CDATA[	if ( Valve_Out AND NOT Feedback_signal ) OR ( NOT Valve_Out AND Feedback_signal ) then]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="39">

<Line Number="40">
<![CDATA[		feedbackTimer.TimerEnable	:=TRUE;]]>

<Line Number="41">
<![CDATA[	else]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="42">
<![CDATA[		feedbackTimer.Reset			:=TRUE;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="43">
<![CDATA[		feedbackTimer.TimerEnable	:=FALSE;]]>

<Line Number="44">

</Line>
<Line Number="45">
<![CDATA[	if feedbackTimer.DN then]]>

<Line Number="46">

</Line>
<Line Number="47">
<![CDATA[		State:=4;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="48">

<Line Number="49">

</Line>
<Line Number="50">
<![CDATA[#region Valve output signal]]>

<![CDATA[	case State of]]>

<Line Number="53">

<Line Number="54">

</Line>
<Line Number="55">
<![CDATA[			Valve_Out:=1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="56">
<![CDATA[		2:/*spare*/]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="57">
<![CDATA[			// currently no operation ]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="58">
<![CDATA[		3:/*Valve is turned on manually*/]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="59">
<![CDATA[			Valve_Out:=1;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="60">
<![CDATA[		4:/*faulted*/]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="61">
<![CDATA[			if 		NO_or_NC then Valve_Out:=0; end_if;]]>
</Line>
<Line Number="62">

<Line Number="63">

</Rung>
<Rung Use="Target" Number="2" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Compute the setpoint in Hz from the setpoint in % that comes in from the HMI - (SetpointHMI in % * 60 = SP in Hz to be sent to VFD) - so 10% speed * 60 = 600 = 6.00 Hz in VFD]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[CPT(VF201_Small_Feeder_2:O.FreqCommand,VF201.SP_HMI*60);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Use="Target" Number="3" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Take the setpoint being written to the drive and convert it to Frequency in Hz]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[DIV(VF201_Small_Feeder_2:O.FreqCommand,100,VF201.FreqHz_Real);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Use="Target" Number="4" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Read the actual drive output in Hz from the drive and scale to a decimal - so 600 = 6.00]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[DIV(VF201_Small_Feeder_2:I.OutputFreq,100,VF201.OT_Actual_Hz);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Use="Target" Number="5" Type="N">
<Comment>

<Routines>
<Routine Name="Logic" Type="RLL">
<RLLContent>
<Rung Number="0" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Figure Out Whate Data Points Need To Be Used Based On The Rate Desired
]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(Rate<0)MOV(0,Rate);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="1" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[SUB(Next_Index,1,Next_Index);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="2" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(Next_Index<0)MOV(4,Next_Index);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="3" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(Rate >= Cal_Points.Cal_Point[Next_Index].Rate)[CMP(Next_Index=4) ,CMP(Next_Index<4) CMP(Rate < Cal_Points.Cal_Point[Next_Index+1].Rate) ]MOV(Next_Index,Index);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="4" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Get the Two Points for the Calculations
if at the top of the graph use the last 2 (index 9 and 8)]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(Index=4)[MOV(4,CP_Index_1) ,MOV(3,CP_Index_2) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="5" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(Index<4)[MOV(Index,CP_Index_1) ,ADD(Index,1,CP_Index_2) ];]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="6" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Move Rate values to a variable]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[MOV(Cal_Points.Cal_Point[CP_Index_1].Rate,Rate1);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="7" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[MOV(Cal_Points.Cal_Point[CP_Index_2].Rate,Rate2);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="8" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Move the Speed Values To a Variable]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[MOV(Cal_Points.Cal_Point[CP_Index_1].Speed,Speed1);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="9" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[MOV(Cal_Points.Cal_Point[CP_Index_2].Speed,Speed2);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="10" Type="N">
<Comment>
<![CDATA[Do the Math
]]>
</Comment>
<Text>
<![CDATA[CPT(Rate_Delta,Rate2-Rate1);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="11" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CPT(Speed_Delta,Speed2-Speed1);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="12" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(Speed_Delta<>0)CPT(Slope,(Speed_Delta)/(Rate_Delta));]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="13" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CMP(Speed_Delta=0)MOV(0,Slope);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="14" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CPT(Zero_Offset,(-(Slope)*Rate1)+Speed1);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>
<Rung Number="15" Type="N">
<Text>
<![CDATA[CPT(Speed,((Slope*Rate)+Zero_Offset)*Cal_Factor);]]>
</Text>
</Rung>

manifest := #(	('https://source.squeak.org/FFI'					1	('FFI-Pools' 'FFI-Kernel' 'FFI-MacOS' 'FFI-Unix' 'FFI-Win32' 'FFI-Tests'))

load := (manifest collect:
				[:tuple|
				[:path :order :packages| | repository |
				repository := MCHttpRepository
								location: path
								user: 'squeak'

			sort: [:a :b| a second <= b second].

	  packages do:
		[:package | | packageVersions latestVersion |
		"We need to filter-out branches of unbranched packages, but can't assume
		the package list is (reverse) ordered."
		packageVersions := ((repository versionNamesForPackageNamed: package)
			select: [:versionName| (versionName at: package size + 1) = $-])
			asSortedCollection: [ :a :b | a versionNumber < b versionNumber ].
		latestVersion := packageVersions last.
		[| version |
       		 version := (MCCacheRepository default versionNamed: latestVersion)
				ifNil: [repository versionNamed: latestVersion].
		 version load.
		 version workingCopy repositoryGroup addRepository: repository]
			on: Warning
			do: [:ex|
				((ex messageText beginsWith: 'This package depends on the following classes')
				 or: [ex messageText beginsWith: 'About to serialize an empty diffy version.']) ifFalse:

		valueWithArguments: tuple].

Write the IEC 61131-3 Structured Text logic for the following program: README.ST

This is the set of common executables for my port of GNU C for Atari
STs.  

Before you go to far, please read the file COPYING.  It explains your
rights and responsibilities as a GNU user.  Basically, it just says
that GNUCC is free, and that nobody has the right to make it anything
other than free.  It also says that there's NO WARRANTY.

This arc contains the 'common' executables of the GNU compiler.  That
means the compiler driver (gcc.ttp), the preprocessor (gcc-cpp.ttp),
the main body (gcc-cc1.ttp), the assembler (gcc-as.ttp) and the linker
(gcc-ld.ttp).  It also contains gcc-ar.ttp, which is the object
library maintainer, for no particular reason other than that I had to
put it somewhere.

All this stuff should go in \gnu\exec\ on your gnu disk, or whatever
you've pointed the env var GCCEXEC at.

Installing:

All this stuff assumes you're running under Gulam.  It'll probly work
with other CLI's, but that's what I use, so I know it works.

To install this stuff, unpack the archive into whatever directory you
want to hold the executables.  I put everything in f:\gnu\exec\, but
you ought to be able to put them anywhere.  Define an env var called
GNULIB that contains the device/directory of the place you've put the
runtime library, header files etc.  That should have NO trailing
backslash.  Define another env var called GCCEXEC whose value is the
default prefix (ie the kind of thing you'd say after "-B") for the
compiler driver.  Note that this value is a
device/dir/partial-pathname, ie "f:\gnu\exec\gcc-".  If you like, you
can incorporate that into the alias for your CC command (ie alias cc
f:\gnu\exec\gcc) but due the all the problems around long command
lines, it's probably not worth the effort.  Finally, you'll need an
env var called TEMP.  It should be the name of a directory for temp
files; again, no trailing backslash. 

At that point, you're done!  You should be able to type "cc foo.c -o
foo.ttp" and have all the obvious things happen.

(A likely story... :-} )

In case of difficulty, I've included a copy of my config file, gnu.g.
Hopefully, if something's misbehaving, you can figure out what you've
done differently than me.

A few words about memory:

GCC loves memory.  A lot.  It loves to cons structures.  Lots of them.
It probably won't run at all in less than 1 Meg; this version will
probably need 2 Meg.  Later (after I get this release out) I plan to
come up with a better scheme for stack initialization, but this
version of cc1 has a 1/2 meg stack, and needs it for compiling large
files with optimization turned on.  Happily, it doesn't need all that
stack for smaller files, or even big files without -O, so it should be
feasible to make a compiler with a smaller stack.  If anyone is
desperate for a version with a different sized stack, let me know and
I'll see about coming up with one.  I may also be able to come up with
a patch that can be applied to an existing executable.

That's about it.  The sources to all these things are packaged
separately, so as to make them easier to distrubute; they should be
appearing on various servers about the time this gets there.

Good Luck.

JRD@Stony-Brook.SCRC.Symbolics.COM

notificationCallback: anArray
	| errorCode offset sourceText lineNumber errorStart errorStop selector methodClass extras notified |
	errorCode := anArray first.
	lineNumber := anArray at: 2.
	errorStart := anArray at: 3.
	errorStop := anArray at: 4.
	"The offset must be added to the error range to get the actual interval in the source text"
	offset := anArray at: 5.
	sourceText := anArray at: 6.
	selector := anArray at: 7.
	methodClass := anArray at: 8.
	notified := anArray at: 9.
	extras := anArray at: 10 ifAbsent: #().
	^notified compilerNotification: ((CompilerNotification
				code: errorCode
				in: sourceText
				for: methodClass
				selector: selector
				position: errorStart + 1
				line: lineNumber
				range: (errorStart to: errorStop) + 1
				extras: extras)
				offset: offset;
				yourself)! !

Write the IEC 61131-3 Structured Text logic for the following program: README.ST

This is the runtime library for my port of GNU CC and related tools.

This should live in \gnu\lib\ on your GNU device, or wherever you want
to keep library code.  Set your env var GNULIB to point to that
directory, without the trailing backslash.

This is a pretty motley collection of code.  It comes from various
places; some is from DLIBS, some is from the public archives on
SIMTEL20, some is from the MUN GCC cross-compiler, some from various
repositories of GNU stuff at MIT.  Some I wrote myself.

Notable kludges to watch out for:

The double-float support (in flonum.s) is pretty ragged.  It's really
just kludged up calls to the single-float stuff.  I suppose I'll get
around to re-writing it one of these days, but if someone else wants
to do it first...

The trap stuff (for TOS calls) is somewhat gross.  Because of this
brain-damage of random-sized args, GCC won't push the right stuff on
the stack for traps, so it has to be done by hand.  Fortunately, there
aren't too many variants, so a smallish number of routines does the
job, but it's still gross.  Hopefully, I'll get around to figuring out
how to use GCC's classy user-definable instruction generation facility
to do the right thing, but for now it's a kludge.


To my knowledge, this code works pretty well, but there are likely
still bugs in it; I'm still finding them fairly frequently.

I guess that's it.  Good luck.

I am an implementation of the command pattern to run a test.

## API

My instances are created with the class method `#selector:`,
passing the symbol that names the method to be executed when the test case runs.

When you discover a new fixture, subclass `TestCase` and create a `#test...` method for the first test.
As that method develops and more `#test...` methods are added, you will find yourself refactoring temps
into instance variables for the objects in the fixture and overriding `#setUp` to initialize these variables.
As required, override `#tearDown` to nil references, release objects and deallocate.!

	| c |
	self errorIfNotAsync: '#async'.
	c := context.
	^ [ self isAsync ifTrue: [ c execute: aBlock ] ]
!

	self errorIfNotAsync: '#finished'.
	asyncTimeout := nil
!

	"Set a grace time timeout in milliseconds to run the test asynchronously"
	
	asyncTimeout ifNotNil: [ asyncTimeout clearTimeout ].
	
	"to allow #async: message send without throwing an error"
	asyncTimeout := 0.
	
	asyncTimeout := (self async: [
		self assert: false description: 'SUnit grace time exhausted' ])
			valueWithTimeout: aNumber
! !

! !

		signal

!TestContext commentStamp!
I govern running a particular test case.

My main added value is `#execute:` method which runs a block as a part of test case (restores context, nilling it afterwards, cleaning/calling `#tearDown` as appropriate for sync/async scenario).!

!TestContext methodsFor: 'accessing'!

! !

!TestContext methodsFor: 'running'!

execute: aBlock
	| failed |
	
	testCase context: self.
	[
		failed := true.
		aBlock value.
		failed := false
	]
		ensure: [
			testCase context: nil.
			
			(failed and: [ testCase isAsync ]) ifTrue: [
				testCase finished ].
			testCase isAsync ifFalse: [
				testCase tearDown ] ]
!

start
	self execute: [
		testCase setUp.
		testCase performTest ]
! !

!TestContext class methodsFor: 'instance creation'!

testCase: aTestCase
	^self new
		testCase: aTestCase;
		yourself
! !

	instanceVariableNames: 'finished result'
	package: 'SUnit'!
!ReportingTestContext commentStamp!
I add `TestResult` reporting to `TestContext`.

Errors are caught and save into a `TestResult`,
When test case is finished (which can be later for async tests), a callback block is executed; this is used by a `TestSuiteRunner`.!

		on: TestFailure
		do: [ :ex | result addFailure: testCase ]
	]
		on: Error
		do: [ :ex | result addError: testCase ]
! !

!ReportingTestContext methodsFor: 'running'!

execute: aBlock
	[
		self withErrorReporting: [ super execute: aBlock ]
	]
		ensure: [
			testCase isAsync ifFalse: [
				result increaseRuns. finished value ] ]
! !

!ReportingTestContext class methodsFor: 'instance creation'!

testCase: aTestCase result: aTestResult finished: aBlock
	^(super testCase: aTestCase)
		result: aTestResult;
		finished: aBlock;
		yourself

I am raised when the boolean parameter of an #`assert:` or `#deny:` call is the opposite of what the assertion claims.

The test framework distinguishes between failures and errors.
A failure is an event whose possibiity is explicitly anticipated and checked for in an assertion,
whereas an error is an unanticipated problem like a division by 0 or an index out of bounds.!

I implement the collecting parameter pattern for running a bunch of tests.

My instances hold tests that have run, sorted into the result categories of passed, failures and errors.

`TestResult` is an interesting object to subclass or substitute. `#runCase:` is the external protocol you need to reproduce!

		ifTrue: [

		ifFalse: ['error']

nextRunDo: aBlock
"Runs aBlock with index of next run
or does nothing if no more runs"

	ifFalse: [ aBlock value: self runs + 1 ]

runCase: aTestCase

	on: TestFailure do: [:ex | self addFailure: aTestCase]]

	announcer announce: (ResultAnnouncement new result: result)

	^ReportingTestContext testCase: (suite at: anInteger) result: result finished: [ self resume ]

Class {
	#name : #Rtf,
	#superclass : #Object,
	#instVars : [
		'writer',
		'colors',
		'fonts',
		'raw',
		'emphasis',
		'color',
		'font',
		'reader',
		'ansi'
	],
	#classVars : [
		'Mapping'
	],
	#category : #RTF
}

{ #category : #services }
Rtf class >> encode: aString [
	^self new append: aString; privateContents]

{ #category : #private }
Rtf class >> initializeMapping [
	"
	Rtf initializeMapping
	"
	Mapping := Dictionary
		with: $\ -> '\\'
		with: ${ -> '\{'
		with: $} -> '\}'
		with: 13 asCharacter -> '\par '
		with: 10 asCharacter -> '']

{ #category : #private }
Rtf class >> mapping [
	Mapping isNil ifTrue: [self initializeMapping].
	^Mapping]

{ #category : #'instance creation' }
Rtf class >> new [
	^super new initialize]

{ #category : #services }
Rtf class >> on: aString [
	self ASSERT: aString isRTFString.
	^self new output: aString trimBlanks appendStream]

{ #category : #services }
Rtf class >> on: aString raw: anotherString [
	self ASSERT: (aString isEmpty or: [aString isRTFString]).
	^self new output: aString trimBlanks appendStream raw: anotherString]

{ #category : #'instance creation' }
Rtf class >> streamContents: aBlock [
	| text |
	text := self new.
	aBlock value: text.
	^text]

{ #category : #'instance creation' }
Rtf class >> with: aString [
	^self new nextPutAll: aString]

{ #category : #accessing }
Rtf >> , text [
	^self copy append: text]

{ #category : #comparing }
Rtf >> << anObject [
	| string |
	string := anObject isString
		ifTrue: [anObject]
		ifFalse: [anObject printString].
	self nextPutAll: string]

{ #category : #comparing }
Rtf >> = anRtf [
	self class == anRtf class ifFalse: [^false].
	self == anRtf ifTrue: [^true].
	^self formattedContents = anRtf formattedContents]

{ #category : #services }
Rtf >> allStringsUnder: cmd [
	^RtfFormattedTextFinder allStringsUnder: cmd in: self]

{ #category : #accessing }
Rtf >> append: text [
	| copy formatted |
	text isNil ifTrue: [
		self ASSERT: false.
		^self].
	text isString ifTrue: [^self nextPutAll: text].
	copy := text copy shiftFonts: fonts; shiftColors: colors.
	formatted := copy privateContents.
	(formatted beginsWith: self plainCommand)
		ifTrue: [formatted := formatted allButFirst: self plainCommand size].
	writer nextPutAll: formatted.
	self rawNextPutAll: copy rawContents.
	self disableCode: [self emphasis: copy emphasis copy]]

{ #category : #services }
Rtf >> appendTo: aStream [
	| code |
	aStream size = 0
		ifTrue: [aStream nextPutAll: self formattedContents]
		ifFalse: [
			code := self privateContents.
			(code beginsWith: '\plain')
				ifTrue: [code := code allButFirst: '\plain' size].
			aStream
				skip: -1;
				nextPutAll: code;
				nextPutAll: ' }']]

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> apply: command [
	self emphasize: command.
	writer space]

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> apply: command to: aString [
	self apply: command while: [self append: aString]]

{ #category : #private }
Rtf >> apply: command while: aBlock [
	self apply: command.
	aBlock ensure: [self apply: (self offCommandFor: command)]]

{ #category : #writing }
Rtf >> arrow [
	"
	'x' asText arrow; append: 'y'
	"
	self
		useFontFace: 'Arial Unicode MS'
		while: [self space; nextPut: $→; space]]

{ #category : #converting }
Rtf >> asParameter [
	^self asString asParameter]

{ #category : #converting }
Rtf >> asString [
	^self rawContents]

{ #category : #converting }
Rtf >> asText [
	^self]

{ #category : #accessing }
Rtf >> beAnsi [
	ansi := true]

{ #category : #accessing }
Rtf >> beSmalltalkCompatible [
	raw lineDelimiters: String cr]

{ #category : #configuration }
Rtf >> beUnicode [

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> bold [
	self apply: self boldCommand]

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> bold: aString [
	self apply: self boldCommand to: aString]

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> bold: aString color: aColor [
	| save |
	save := self color.
	self
		setCharColor: aColor;
		bold: aString;
		setCharColor: save]

{ #category : #commands }

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> boldOff [

	off := self offCommandFor: self boldCommand.
	self apply: off]

{ #category : #'math symbols' }
Rtf >> capitalABar [

	'' asText capitalABar
	"
	self useFontFace: 'Arial Unicode MS' while: [self nextPut: $Ā]]

{ #category : #writing }
Rtf >> cdot [

	'x' asText cdot; append: 'y'
	"

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> center: aString [

{ #category : #commands }
Rtf >> centerCommand [

	'' asText checkMark
	"

{ #category : #'private services' }
Rtf >> codeFor: aCharacter [
	| cp bytes code1 code2 |
	cp := aCharacter codePoint.
	cp < 128 ifTrue: [^Mapping at: aCharacter ifAbsent: [aCharacter]].
	ansi ifFalse: [^aCharacter].
	cp < 16r8000 ifTrue: [^'\u' , cp asString , '?'].
	cp < 16r10000 ifTrue: [^'\u' , (16r10000 - cp) asString , '?'].
	bytes := UTF16 current encode: aCharacter asString.
	cp := bytes shortAtOffset: 0.
	code1 := cp < 16r8000
		ifTrue: ['\u' , cp asString , '?']
		ifFalse: ['\u' , (16r10000 - cp) asString , '?'].
	cp := bytes shortAtOffset: 2.
	code2 := cp < 16r8000
		ifTrue: ['\u' , cp asString , '?']
		ifFalse: ['\u' , (16r10000 - cp) asString , '?'].
	^code1 , code2]

{ #category : #accessing }
Rtf >> color [
	^color]

{ #category : #private }
Rtf >> color: aColor [
	color := aColor asRGBColor]

{ #category : #private }
Rtf >> commandsDo: aBlock [
	RtfCommandIterator new block: aBlock; parse: writer contents]

{ #category : #accessing }
Rtf >> contents [
	| token1 token2 result n head |
	token1 := '{\urtf'.
	token2 := '{\rtf1'.
	self ASSERT: token1 size = token2 size.
	result := '' writeStream.
	n := token1 size min: self size.
	head := writer readStream next: n.
	(head = token1
		or: [head allButLast = token2 allButLast and: [head last isDigit]])
		ifTrue: [result nextPutAll: writer contents]
		ifFalse: [
			self writeHeaderOn: result.
			result nextPutAll: writer contents; nextPutAll: '\par}'].
	^result position: 0]

{ #category : #writing }

	raw cr.
	writer nextPutAll: '\par ']

{ #category : #writing }
Rtf >> crtab [
	self cr; tab]

{ #category : #writing }
Rtf >> crtab: n [
	self cr; tab: n]

{ #category : #writing }
Rtf >> cubic [
	self super: '3']

{ #category : #writing }
Rtf >> degree [
	"
	'' asText degree; append: 'C'
	"
	self useFontFace: 'Arial Unicode MS' while: [self nextPut: $º]]

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> dotUnderline: aString [
	self apply: self dotUnderlineCommand to: aString]

{ #category : #commands }
Rtf >> dotUnderlineCommand [
	^'\uld']

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> doubleUnderline: aString [
	self apply: self doubleUnderlineCommand; append: aString; underlineOff]

{ #category : #commands }
Rtf >> doubleUnderlineCommand [
	^'\uldb']

{ #category : #'private services' }
Rtf >> dumpCommandOn: aStream [
	| char cmd digit |
	aStream nextPut: reader next.
	char := reader next.
	aStream nextPut: char.
	cmd := aStream contents.
	cmd = '\*' ifTrue: [
		reader upTo: $}.
		^self].
	cmd = '\\' ifTrue: [^self].
	(cmd = '\u' and: [reader peek isDigit or: [reader peek = $-]])
		ifTrue: [^self dumpUnicodeCommandOn: aStream].
	(char isAlphanumeric or: [self isCodeMark: char]) ifFalse: [^self].
	digit := false.
	[| loop |
		reader atEnd ifTrue: [^self].
		char := reader peek.
		char isDigit ifTrue: [digit := true].
		loop := digit ifTrue: [char isDigit] ifFalse: [char isAlphanumeric].
		loop and: [(self isPrintable: aStream contents) not]]
		whileTrue: [aStream nextPut: reader next].
	reader peek = $  ifTrue: [reader next].
	(aStream contents endsWith: '\par')
		ifTrue: [reader peekFor: Character cr; peekFor: Character lf]]

{ #category : #'private services' }
Rtf >> dumpUnicodeCommandOn: aStream [
	| negative cmd |
	negative := reader peekFor: $-.
	cmd := reader untilAnySatisfying: [:c | c isDigit not].
	negative ifTrue: [aStream nextPut: $-].
	aStream nextPutAll: cmd.
	(reader peekFor: $?) ifTrue: [aStream nextPut: $?].
	^self]

	self nextPut: Emdash]

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> emphasis: aCollection [
	emphasis notEmpty ifTrue: [
		emphasis do: [:cmd | 
			(aCollection includes: cmd)
				ifFalse: [self emphasize: (self offCommandFor: cmd)]].
		writer space].
	aCollection notEmpty ifTrue: [
		aCollection
			do: [:cmd | (emphasis includes: cmd) ifFalse: [self emphasize: cmd]].
		writer space]]

{ #category : #emphasis }
Rtf >> emphasize: command [
	| cmd |
	cmd := command trimBlanks.
	writer nextPutAll: cmd.
	(self resetsEmphasis: command) ifTrue: [
		emphasis removeAll.
		self color: self defaultColor].
	cmd = self plainCommand ifTrue: [^self].
	(self isOffCommand: cmd)
		ifTrue: [(self onCommandsFor: cmd)
			do: [:c | emphasis remove: c ifAbsent: nil]]
		ifFalse: [emphasis add: cmd]]

{ #category : #writing }
Rtf >> endLinesOf: aString withLineFeeds: aBoolean [
	| crlf cr |
	(aString includes: Character cr) ifFalse: [^aString].
	aBoolean = (aString includes: Lf) ifTrue: [^aString].
	crlf := String with: Cr with: Lf.
	cr := String with: Cr.
	^aBoolean
		ifTrue: [aString replaceAllChar: Cr with: crlf]
		ifFalse: [aString replaceAll: crlf with: cr]]

{ #category : #accessing }
Rtf >> eol [

	| string i0 write dye index |
	string := writer contents.
	i0 := 0.

	self commandsDo: [:cmd :arg :i | 
		write
			nextPutAll: (string copyFrom: i0 + 1 to: i);
			nextPutAll: cmd.
		index := arg asInteger.
		(cmd = 'cf' and: [index > 0]) ifTrue: [
			dye := colors at: arg asInteger ifAbsent: [].
			dye notNil
				ifTrue: [index := colorCollection
					indexOf: dye
					ifAbsent: [colorCollection add: dye; size]]].
		arg notEmpty ifTrue: [write nextPutAll: index printString].
		i0 := i + cmd size + arg size].
	write nextPutAll: (string copyFrom: i0 + 1).
	writer reset nextPutAll: write contents; truncate.

if (LIBINT2_ENABLE_MPFR)

    set(LIBINT_HAS_MPFR 1)

    get_property(_loc TARGET Multiprecision::gmp PROPERTY LOCATION)
    message(VERBOSE "${Cyan}Found GMP${ColourReset}: ${_loc}")
    get_property(_loc TARGET Multiprecision::gmpxx PROPERTY LOCATION)
    message(VERBOSE "${Cyan}Found GMPXX${ColourReset}: ${_loc}")
    get_property(_loc TARGET Multiprecision::mpfr PROPERTY LOCATION)
    message(VERBOSE "${Cyan}Found MPFR${ColourReset}: ${_loc} (found version ${MPFR_VERSION})")
endif()

if (LIBINT2_REQUIRE_CXX_API)
    if (NOT TARGET Boost::headers)
        find_package(Boost 1.57)
    endif()
    if (TARGET Boost::headers)
        include(int_checkboost)
        set(LIBINT_HAS_SYSTEM_BOOST_PREPROCESSOR_VARIADICS 1)
    else()
        set(LIBINT_HAS_SYSTEM_BOOST_PREPROCESSOR_VARIADICS 0)

        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/include/libint2)
        execute_process(
          COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E tar xzf ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/external/boost.tar.gz
          WORKING_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/include/libint2
          RESULT_VARIABLE UNPACK_BOOST_RESULT
          OUTPUT_VARIABLE UNPACK_BOOST_OUTPUT
          ERROR_VARIABLE UNPACK_BOOST_OUTPUT
          )
        message(STATUS "Unpacking bundled Boost")
        if (NOT UNPACK_BOOST_RESULT EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Failed to unpack the bundled Boost! The tar command output:\n${UNPACK_BOOST_OUTPUT}")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

find_package(Eigen3 MODULE)

set(LIBINT2_CXX_STANDARD 11)
if (TARGET Eigen3::Eigen)
    set(LIBINT_HAS_EIGEN 1)

    if (EIGEN3_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL "3.5.0")

    endif()

endif()

  )

  )

      )

  )

endif()
